newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nisseki appoints new president from Ono group.
newsitem.headline: Nisseki appoints new president from Ono group.

text.p: Japanese prefabricated house maker Nisseki House Industry Co Ltd said on Thursday it appointed Shigeru Hatanaka, current president of Ono Warehouse Co Ltd, as its new president effective June 27.
The company said in a statement that it would also accept new board members from its main creditor bank Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and major shareholder Ono group.
Among the likely new board members are Kotaro Ono, current representative of the Ono group, and Toshiyuki Sugawara, an executive at DKB, the company said.
Nisseki said the change in personnel would stabilise the company's management and help improve its business.
In January, Nisseki House issued new shares worth 9.65 billion yen to the Ono corporate group, allowing it to acquire about 34 percent interest in Nisseki House.

Nisseki said in January that it had not been able to contact its then-president Saburo Horiuchi since December 11, and his family reported his disappearance to the police on December 22. Vice president Yuji Horiuchi, son of Saburo Horiuchi, has since been the acting president.
